unstuck_said.text: Filed companion-rail issue #1: propose a feeless Nano settle leg as the micro-payment arm beside the rotating USDC wallet, so sub-swap-minimum calls and agents with no USDC can still pay. Grounded in their Zcash treasury + rotating wallet + Tor isolation model and their own documented swap-minimum constraint.
